title: Sky's the Limit
author: Rick Mohr
problems: Row 3 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 4 "neighbors promenade across" can't start from where the dancers are: To promenade across, neighbors must stand side by side on one side.
Row 5 "slide right along set" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 (couple 1) must stand on a side line.
Row 8 "robins allemande right ¾" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 1 and 3 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
Row 9 "robins allemande left ¾ (next robins), larks shift left" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 1 and 3 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
Row 10 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
